verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a business banking SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence never mentions a public API. Every documented workflow (account details, card freezing, limits, invoices, approvals) is described as a step in the Relay app UI. The QuickBooks, Xero and Plaid integrations and the support-site llms.txt are not a general-purpose API offering UI parity.
